notes: Manufacturer site (dorrough.com) presented an invalid TLS certificate (matches *.bizland.com, not dorrough.com) and was unusable per HTTPS-verification requirement. No modern retailer (B&H, Sweetwater, Markertek, Full Compass) spec page for this exact legacy model was fetchable (403s / no matching product). Specs instead come from the original Dorrough Electronics "Model 40-A" Instruction Manual, hosted on ManualsLib (a legitimate manual-archive host) and cross-checked against a matching scan on SteamPoweredRadio.com. Per that manual: rear panel has only a single "terminal strip" per channel with L+/L-, R+/R- screw terminals (mapped here to the closest allowed id, "euroblock" — it is a fixed barrier-strip terminal block, not a pluggable Euroblock/Phoenix connector, but functionally the same screw-terminal style) and a recessed captive AC cord (mapped to nema-5-15 per the "US captive cord/inlet" rule). No audio output connector is documented — the 40-A is a passive bridging input meter only, with no loop-through or output jack. No RJ45/DIN/relay connector exists on this base 40-A (that mini 8-pin DIN alarm/relay port and XLR inputs belong to the later, distinct "40-A2" model — do not conflate the two). rackUnits (2 / "2U") reflects the optional single-meter rack adapter panel (part 40A-S, 19in x 3.5in); the base 40-A ships panel-mount/caseless in several body configurations, not inherently rack-eared. Power line voltage is stated as 110VAC in this manual revision; later units/export variants may differ. No bandwidth-graded connectors are present, so no "grade" values were set.

ports.name: L Input
ports.note: Balanced bridging L+/L- audio input on rear barrier terminal strip (20kΩ balanced / 10kΩ unbalanced); also doubles as the mono input

ports.name: R Input
ports.note: Balanced bridging R+/R- audio input on rear barrier terminal strip (20kΩ balanced / 10kΩ unbalanced)

ports.name: AC Cord
ports.note: Recessed, non-detachable (captive) AC line cord; 110VAC nominal per this manual revision
